\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\sn}{\smallskip\noindent}
\newcommand{\mn}{\sn\medskip}
\begin{document}
\mn
\textbf{Fact $(\alpha)$}: Each tree is a graph.

\sn
Proof: By renaming. \qed

{
{\noindent \bf Remark}  A path is a tree.
}

{\bf Proposision 9.2.7}\quad Each cycle is a graph.

Call such a tree good.\\[5pt] \noindent
\textbf{Claim 1.}  Each good tree is a path.

{\underline {\bf Convention:}} A graph is finite.

\!\!\!\! \textbf{Question:}
Is each graph a tree?

\newtheorem{corollary}{Corollary}
\begin{corollary}
Each path is a graph.
\end{corollary}
